results.title: Canada to announce retaliatory tariffs against US as Trump threatens 50% duties on autos, steel
results.description: Canada is set to announce retaliatory tariffs against the US after trade talks collapsed, escalating tensions as Trump threatens 50 per cent tariffs on Canadian autos, steel and aluminium.
